summary.en-US: Keep one Firefox network identity consistent: proxy, public IP, approximate location, timezone, and WebRTC.

version.approval_notes: Reviewer notes for the current candidate are in docs/AMO-REVIEW.md in the source archive; the eventual submission version is authoritative in manifest.json. Firefox desktop minimum 140.0; no maximum. Schema 4 migrates versions 1–3, removes durable proxy usernames, and preserves the applied route independently of newer saved edits. Both proxy username and password live only in storage.session. Required authenticationInfo discloses existing credentials sent only to the user-selected proxy; required locationInfo and optional personallyIdentifyingInfo for direct GeoIP remain. Required-data update prompts may change. Fresh install makes no GeoIP request. Save changes stored configuration only; Apply changes runtime; blank credential fields keep the pair, either entered field replaces it, Clear removes the saved pair, and Duplicate copies no credentials. Terminal proxy lists and the blocking startup gate preserve fail-closed routing. Passive SOCKS health uses bounded request/generation/endpoint evidence, reports suspected trouble rather than proven outage, and applies bounded cooldown without HTTP replay, route changes or identity resets. Real Firefox tests include repeated flaps, outages, startup/restart, session-auth loss, HTTP/HTTPS/WS/WSS and proxy DNS with zero direct sentinel hits. The offline coordinate picker makes no tile requests. Four store screenshots show actual fixture UI from an unsigned candidate and do not imply Mozilla approval. The unlisted pipeline and credential isolation remain unchanged: exact Mozilla-signed XPI, AMO hash/payload verification, and permanent signature-enforcing stable Firefox installation before public release. Existing listed submissions and historical assets remain unchanged. No custom update URL; GitHub does not automatically update installations. See docs/PRIVACY.md.
